label: first copy step after <DEL> in length-9 sequences, mostly when first token is a/p/k/l
explanation: Fires essentially only at the step right after <DEL> (input = the first original token fed back, output = original token 1), and almost only in L=9 sequences (97% of mass; a few at L=8). Never fires in the original or delimiter phases or later copy steps. Within that slot it is sparse (~2% of L=9 slots) and selective for the first token: a carries ~59% of mass and the largest activations, then p, k, l; second token h/j/i/b raises rate further. Position+length alone gives 96% mass recall but 2% precision; adding first-token in {a,p,k,l} gives ~90% mass recall at ~14% precision. Exact token combination that triggers it not captured; tiny magnitude overall.
